name: mcp-atlassian-extended
description: MCP 2026-07-28 server for Jira and Confluence: sprints, boards, attachments, versions, calendars.

settings.name: JIRA_USERNAME
settings.description: Jira Cloud account email. With JIRA_API_TOKEN this takes precedence over any token below.

settings.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
settings.description: Jira Cloud API token, used with JIRA_USERNAME (basic auth)

settings.name: JIRA_PAT
settings.description: Jira personal access token for Data Center (aliases: JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN, JIRA_TOKEN). Ignored when JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_API_TOKEN are both set.

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_URL
settings.description: Confluence instance URL (optional, for Confluence tools). Cloud URLs usually need the /wiki suffix.

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_USERNAME
settings.description: Confluence Cloud account email. With CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN this takes precedence over any token below.

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
settings.description: Confluence Cloud API token, used with CONFLUENCE_USERNAME (basic auth)

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_PAT
settings.description: Confluence personal access token for Data Center (aliases: CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN, CONFLUENCE_TOKEN). Confluence tools also require the Team Calendars add-on.
